items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I met Claude Hopkins in Dallas, while I was in Dallas and I met some of the musicians, and some of the musicians -- Andy Kirk was there.

ctx.x:
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC.
WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

had Foots Sims playing drums and Adam Cato played piano and who else -- Anderson, Andy Anderson played trumpet, but it was Clarence Hall who reminded me of the real New Orleans style of blowing. And he would bounce along with that rhythm. He gets his rhythm by moving up and down his chair. He would just blow out a storm. He never left New Orleans. He was a typical New Orleans style musician. They were great the way they were. I was so pleased that I was able to be in New Orleans. Now, in New Orleans, there's a…
Did they ever bring their instruments over and jam sometimes?
